paths.name: usb_data_chain
constraints: J1-to-U2 connector-side fan-out may use a reviewed, bounded F.Cu/B.Cu crossover only to join the reversible contacts before the two-line protector
each connector-side signal-layer transition requires a nearby GND return-via pair
U2-to-U1 through R4/R5 remains F.Cu only over a continuous In1.Cu GND reference

paths.name: target_j3_esd_bank
constraints: J3 is a target-side interface: VTREF is a target-provided reference input and must never be tied to probe 3V3 or USB_5V.
Each signal enters its assigned ESD cathode before continuing to the internal control path.
Each ESD anode retains an independent short F.Cu route to a through via and the In1.Cu GND plane.
Do not infer impedance or length matching from this low-speed target-interface path.
